audit.whatIsWrong: Lane difficulty prose is right in tone (45.01% over 1333 games, TRICKY 7/10) but the full-layer level chart contradicts the content layer on five of seven rows, so the page renders two different answers to who wins each stage.
audit.why: packet.levelChart and content win[0..6] both read Sylas/Sylas/Sylas/Sylas/Azir/Skill/Azir. full phases[].side reads Sylas/Sylas/Skill/Skill/Sylas/Skill/Skill. phases[4].why already argues Azir wins level 6 while its side said Sylas — the row argued with itself.
audit.corrected: full phases[2].side and [3].side -> Sylas, phases[4].side -> Azir, phases[6].side -> Azir, each with its why rewritten to match the verdict. Content win[] already carries the correct values, so no content-layer chart edit is required.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text never names Hijack's effect on this specific matchup: Sylas's R steals Emperor's Divide, which is the single largest thing his level 6 does to Azir.
audit.why: Enemy kit R: 'Sylas steals the enemy's ultimate ability and can cast it freely', 80/55/30s. Azir R is a 120/105/90s knockback wall. A Sylas holding a copy of Emperor's Divide inverts Azir's dive insurance and his insec.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now warns that Hijack copies Emperor's Divide and to bait his R before committing; the loading line carries the same warning.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every Abscond reference described it as 'Dash into chain-stun' and quoted a fifteen-second cooldown; Abduct pulls, it does not stun, and Abscond is 13/12/11/10/9. Azir's Shifting Sands was quoted at nineteen seconds when rank 1 is 22s. The Chain Lash 775 vs Conquering Sands 740 range gap was never stated anywhere.
audit.why: Enemy kit: E Abscond 13/12/11/10/9, 400 range, dash; recast Abduct is a projectile that pulls him to an enemy the chain hits. Q Chain Lash 775 range, 10/9/8/7/6. W Kingslayer 12/10.5/9/7.5/6, heals against champions. Owner kit: Q 740 range, E Shifting Sands 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns now carries Abscond 13s/9s, Kingslayer 12s with the Grievous Wounds cue, and Hijack 80s stealing your R; tradeBad states the 775-vs-740 range loss; report[5].t describes Abduct as a pull off the chain rather than a stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere, and breakdown.cooldowns contained the word 'matchup-defining' with no digit in it.
audit.why: Defect catalogue item 3: breakdown.cooldowns must contain a real number.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with 13s/9s Abscond, 12s Kingslayer and 80s Hijack.

audit.why: missingInteractions flagged needs-antiheal for Kingslayer sustain; report[8].t already says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain'. Reinforced in breakdown.cooldowns with the 12s timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim under a roaming title, dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string under a pinging title, and dontsFull[0].d ('bread-and-butter play') did not address its own title about burning E.
audit.corrected: All three bodies rewritten to answer their own titles.

edits.after: Azir

edits.before: Full build Azir is a teamfight: R cuts the fight in half, soldiers melt whoever is on your side of the wall.
edits.after: Full build you outrange him: R cuts the fight in half, and Sylas has to spend Abscond into sand to touch you.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - E Shifting Sands is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Abscond (E) is 13s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5 — the Abduct recast only lands if the chain hits, so sidestep the throw, not the dash. - Kingslayer (W) is 12s and heals off you — Grievous Wounds before long trades. - Hijack (R) 80s at rank 1 steals your R.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Sylas wins by chaining Abscond into Abduct onto you, healing the poke back with Kingslayer, and stealing Emperor's Divide to end you with it.

edits.before: He has to enter soldier range to kill you — that trip costs HP, and your E + R make the return trip expensive too.
edits.after: He must spend Abscond (13s) to reach you — that jump costs HP, and Shifting Sands plus Emperor's Divide make the exit costly.

edits.before: He has to enter soldier range to kill you — that trip costs HP, and your E + R make the return trip expensive too.
edits.after: He must spend Abscond (13s) to reach you — that jump costs HP, and Shifting Sands plus Emperor's Divide make the exit costly.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Sylas player is waiting for.
edits.after: Poking at max range with Shifting Sands down — Chain Lash out-ranges your Q at 775 to 740, so he wins that exchange and can still Abscond in.

edits.before: Good trade: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Sylas on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending. Great trade: Sylas wastes Abscond / Abduct — commit immediately. edits.after: Good trade: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Sylas on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending. Great trade: Sylas wastes Abscond — commit for the next 13 seconds. Bad trade: Poking at max range with Shifting Sands down — Chain Lash out-ranges your Q at 775 to 740, so he wins that exchange and can still Abscond in.

edits.before: Track Sylas’s Abscond / Abduct: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. It’s down or you don’t go.
edits.after: Track Abscond (13s at rank 1): the Abduct recast pulls him to whatever the chain hits. It’s down or you don’t go.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: He must enter soldier range to reach you — keep sand on that line and count the 13s E.

edits.before: W behind the wave, Q-drag the soldier through Sylas on his last-hit, auto once through the soldier, step back — two-second trades he cannot answer without overextending.
edits.after: Crash the wave with soldier autos, then ping and match his roam — his kill pressure elsewhere is what makes this lane hurt, and you lose nothing by shoving into his tower.

edits.before: Sylas burns Abscond / Abduct on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Emperor's Divide knocks him back mid-dive and walls him off — spend it on his commit.

edits.before: That’s Sylas’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Shifting Sands is your only escape from Abduct — keep it for the pull, not for chip.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Sylas player is waiting for.
edits.after: A silent Sylas is a Sylas arriving in another lane with W healing him through the gank — ping the moment he leaves your soldiers' range.

edits.before: If Sylas opens the score, reset expectations and respect Abscond / Abduct doubly. After a second, your job description changes — farm at soldier range and stay relevant through wave control.
edits.after: A fed Sylas reaches you through the soldier screen anyway, so stop contesting the wave and farm the back rank under tower. He still spends Abscond to get in — those 13s are your window to reset or cross river.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.
edits.after: You carry by taxing his entry: Abscond is one 13s jump and Emperor's Divide waits for it, while sand beats Chain Lash chip over a long fight.

edits.before: Best wave: a controlled slow push you crash with soldier autos — the crash funds your roam, your plates, and your scuttle-fight presence. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with your E down — walking up to reset it is the most-ganked walk in mid lane. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or roam, but never just because.
edits.after: Best wave: shove with soldier autos so he cannot freeze — a Sylas with a slow push and Abscond up owns the lane. Worst wave: a frozen wave near his tower with Shifting Sands down; walking up to reset it is the dive he wants. Crash timing: crash before his Kingslayer heal makes a long trade free, then reset or match his roam.

edits.before: Ahead, siege: crash waves with soldier autos, take every plate, and rotate to river with R held — your wall converts even fights into massacres.
edits.after: Ahead, deny him levels: shove with soldier autos, take plates, and hold Emperor's Divide for the moment he Abscond-dives — the wall ends the jump.

edits.before: - Azir vs Sylas - Track: Sylas Abscond / Abduct. - Poke through soldiers on his last-hits — never step past your own sand. - Abscond / Abduct down is the green light. - Hold the ult for names, not waves.
edits.after: - Azir vs Sylas - Track: Abscond, 13s at rank 1. - Poke on his last-hits — never step past your own sand. - Abscond down is the green light. - Hijack copies Emperor's Divide, so bait his R first.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 remain his window too — his dash-heal loop still beats Azir's ranged poke whenever he commits, matching the rough laning phase described.
edits.after: Level 3 is his: Abscond in, Chain Lash to slow, Kingslayer to heal the trade back, and Shifting Sands is the only exit you own — save it.

notes: Full-layer chart disagreed with content win[] on rows 2,3,4,6; content and packet agreed, so the full layer was moved to them and each why rewritten in the same proposal. phases[].rating left untouched — the existing values (6/10 on Sylas rows, 5/10 on Skill rows) do not map to a scale I can ground from the kit, and I did not want to invent one. Sylas's Hijack copying Emperor's Divide was absent from the entire matchup and is now in phases[4].why, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns and loading. Chain Lash 775 out-ranges Conquering Sands 740 — stated in tradeBad; the old text implied he had to enter soldier range to do anything, which is only true of his kill threat. Anti-heal interaction (missingInteractions key 19) was already present in report[8].t and is now timed against Kingslayer's 12s in breakdown.cooldowns.
